Name: Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion - German Full Translation
Author: neroxii
Description:
This is the full translation to German of the Mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]" from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/gizzymo?gameId=1303]gizzymo[/url]. I sticked as close as possible to the English original to not alter the essence of what the characters say. This adds in total more than 5000 lines of Dialogue across all characters in Stardew Valley.

This is made for the 3.0.9 (release 09. October 2025) of the original Mod so it should be up to date. As it is only an translation, just put the "de.json" into the path: "Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion-2544-3-0-9-1759968489\[CP] Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion\i18n"

This is my first mod ever. So please be kind.
